description_en: Retrieves the details of a specific member in a Workspace
description_zh: 查询工作空间成员详情
name: GetProjectMember

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks Workspace. You can sign in to the DataWorks Console (https://dataworks.console.aliyun.com/workspace/list) and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the Workspace ID.

This parameter is used to identify the DataWorks workspace that you want to access
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://dataworks.console.aliyun.com/workspace/list)，进入工作空间管理页面获取ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user. To find the ID, sign in to the DataWorks Console (https://dataworks.console.aliyun.com/product/ms_menu), go to the Management Center, select the target Workspace, and open the Tenant Members and Roles page
parameters.help_zh: Dataworks账号 ID。您可以登录 DataWorks 控制台——管理中心 (https://dataworks.console.aliyun.com/product/ms_menu)，选择需要操作的工作空间进入管理中心页面，进入租户成员与角色页面，查看需要操作的账号 ID
parameters.name: user_id

ProjectMember.description_en: The details of the Workspace member

Roles.description_zh: 工作空间成员已经授予的空间角色列表

items.description_zh: 已授予的空间角色详情

Code.description_en:
The code of the Workspace role.

The built-in system roles in a DataWorks Workspace include:

role_project_admin: Workspace Administrator

role_project_dev: Developer

role_project_dg_admin: Data Governance Administrator

role_project_guest: Guest

role_project_security: Security Administrator

role_project_deploy: Deployment

role_project_owner: Workspace Owner

role_project_data_analyst: Data Analyst

role_project_pe: O\&M (Operations & Maintenance)

role_project_erd: Model Designer
Code.description_zh:
工作空间的角色 Code。

Dataworks系统内置的工作空间角色：

role_project_admin  空间管理员
role_project_dev 开发
role_project_dg_admin 数据治理管理员
role_project_guest 访客
role_project_security 安全管理员
role_project_deploy 部署
role_project_owner 工作空间所有者
role_project_data_analyst 数据分析师
role_project_pe 运维
role_project_erd 模型设计师

Name.description_en: The name of the Workspace role

The type of the Workspace role.

Type.description_zh:

UserCustom 用户自定义角色

Status.description_en:
The status of the Workspace member.

Normal: The member is active.

Disabled: The member is disabled

Normal 正常。
